why: This exact mutation SURVIVED the whole suite before the seam was extracted -- measured, not supposed. Without the VS branch a versus session falls back to the derived positional rule, so bots land in the LAST slots regardless of where the player put them and the pane's displayed assignment is silently discarded at Start. That is the precise defect issue #260 opens with, and it is invisible to every test that only checks a match starts.
